title: DC Motor Operation
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating how DC motors convert electrical energy to mechanical rotation. Shows voltage control, back EMF, torque, current flow, and motor efficiency with animated armature rotation.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: electricity
motors
electromagnetism
physics
energy conversion
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of dc motor operation
Explore dc motor operation through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of dc motor operation to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on dc motor operation
